source.name: BofA Global Investment Strategy · The Longest Pictures (6th edition)
source.name_en: BofA Global Investment Strategy · The Longest Pictures (6th edition)

note: 25 market maxims, EN only. English text quoted verbatim from BofA The Longest Pictures; scroll to flip one by one.

quotes.en: Those classes of investments considered 'best' change from period to period. The pathetic fallacy is what are thought to be the best are in truth only the most popular — the most active, the most talked of, the most boosted, and consequently, the highest in price at that time.
quotes.zh: Those classes of investments considered 'best' change from period to period. The pathetic fallacy is what are thought to be the best are in truth only the most popular — the most active, the most talked of, the most boosted, and consequently, the highest in price at that time.

quotes.en: Markets stop panicking when central banks start panicking.
quotes.zh: Markets stop panicking when central banks start panicking.

quotes.en: When all the experts and forecasts agree — something else is going to happen.
quotes.zh: When all the experts and forecasts agree — something else is going to happen.

quotes.en: If there are two rules in investing they are that magnificent portfolios attract inflows, and inflows ultimately destroy magnificent portfolios.
quotes.zh: If there are two rules in investing they are that magnificent portfolios attract inflows, and inflows ultimately destroy magnificent portfolios.

quotes.en: Buy on the cannons, sell on the trumpets.
quotes.zh: Buy on the cannons, sell on the trumpets.

quotes.en: We simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful.
quotes.zh: We simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful.

quotes.en: Successful investing is anticipating the anticipations of others.
quotes.zh: Successful investing is anticipating the anticipations of others.

quotes.en: The four most dangerous words in investing are 'This time it's different.'
quotes.zh: The four most dangerous words in investing are 'This time it's different.'

quotes.en: There are two types of forecasters: those that don't know, and those that don't know they don't know.
quotes.zh: There are two types of forecasters: those that don't know, and those that don't know they don't know.

quotes.en: Little else is requisite to carry a state to the highest degree of opulence from the lowest barbarism but peace, easy taxes, tolerable administration of justice.
quotes.zh: Little else is requisite to carry a state to the highest degree of opulence from the lowest barbarism but peace, easy taxes, tolerable administration of justice.

quotes.en: Wall Street's favorite short is always 'denial' and Wall Street's favorite long is 'panic'.
quotes.zh: Wall Street's favorite short is always 'denial' and Wall Street's favorite long is 'panic'.

quotes.en: There are only three ways to meet the unpaid bills of a nation. The first is taxation. The second is repudiation. The third is inflation.
quotes.zh: There are only three ways to meet the unpaid bills of a nation. The first is taxation. The second is repudiation. The third is inflation.

quotes.en: Inflation is like toothpaste. Once it's out, you can hardly get it back in again.
quotes.zh: Inflation is like toothpaste. Once it's out, you can hardly get it back in again.

quotes.en: Nothing is so permanent as a temporary government program.
quotes.zh: Nothing is so permanent as a temporary government program.

quotes.en: There are no new eras — excesses are never permanent.
quotes.zh: There are no new eras — excesses are never permanent.

quotes.en: The average long-term experience in investing is never surprising, but the short-term experience is always surprising.
quotes.zh: The average long-term experience in investing is never surprising, but the short-term experience is always surprising.

quotes.en: Buy humiliation, sell hubris.
quotes.zh: Buy humiliation, sell hubris.

quotes.en: Markets can remain irrational longer than you can remain solvent.
quotes.zh: Markets can remain irrational longer than you can remain solvent.

quotes.en: Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world. He who understands it, earns it … he who doesn't … pays it.
quotes.zh: Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world. He who understands it, earns it … he who doesn't … pays it.

quotes.en: In economics, things take longer to happen than you think they will, and then happen faster than you thought they could.
quotes.zh: In economics, things take longer to happen than you think they will, and then happen faster than you thought they could.

quotes.en: Never in the field of monetary policy was so much gained by so few at the expense of so many.
quotes.zh: Never in the field of monetary policy was so much gained by so few at the expense of so many.

quotes.en: Speculation is an effort to turn a little money into a lot. Investment is an effort to prevent a lot of money from becoming a little.
quotes.zh: Speculation is an effort to turn a little money into a lot. Investment is an effort to prevent a lot of money from becoming a little.

quotes.en: If all the economists were laid end to end, they'd never reach a conclusion.
quotes.zh: If all the economists were laid end to end, they'd never reach a conclusion.

quotes.en: Past performance is not necessarily a guide to future performance.
quotes.zh: Past performance is not necessarily a guide to future performance.

quotes.en: The long run is a misleading guide to current affairs. In the long run we are all dead.
quotes.zh: The long run is a misleading guide to current affairs. In the long run we are all dead.
